description: Track one Belgian train by its number — is my Belgian train delayed. All stops with scheduled vs actual times, per-stop delay in minutes, platforms, current delay, and live position. Accepts "IC 1832", "IC1832", or "BE.NMBS.IC1832". Train numbers come from irail_liveboard or irail_journey. Example: irail_train({ id: "IC1832" })

date.description: Optional travel date "YYYY-MM-DD" (default today, Belgian time)

name: irail_train
title: Irail Train
